about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Meet Captain Nikos and learn about our passion for fishing
about.captainBio: With over 20 years of experience fishing in Amvrakikos Bay, Captain Nikos knows all the best spots and techniques to ensure you have an unforgettable experience.
about.boatSpecs: Our fully equipped fishing vessel is designed for comfort and safety, featuring modern navigation equipment and plenty of space for up to 6 guests.
about.safetyDesc: Your safety is our priority. We maintain the highest safety standards with certified equipment and regular inspections.
about.experienceDesc: We've hosted thousands of guests from around the world and pride ourselves on creating memorable fishing adventures.
about.mission: Our mission is to share the culture and beauty of Amvrakikos Bay while delivering exceptional, safe, and personalized fishing trips.
about.teamDesc: A dedicated team of local experts committed to making every trip special.
about.historyDesc: Founded in 2005 as a family passion project, Amvrakikos Fishing Trips has become a trusted name for authentic coastal adventures.
about.missionDetail: Create unforgettable days on the water with tailored itineraries, fresh catches, and true Greek hospitality.
about.valuesDesc: Respect for the sea, sustainable fishing practices, and warm hospitality guide everything we do.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our fishing trips

booking1.question: How far in advance should I book?
booking1.answer: We recommend booking at least a week in advance, especially during summer, to secure your preferred date.

booking2.question: Can I reschedule my trip?
booking2.answer: Yes. Let us know at least 48 hours ahead of time and we'll find a new date for you.

trips1.question: Do I need previous fishing experience?
trips1.answer: Not at all. Our crew will guide you through everything, from casting to handling your catch.

trips2.question: What should I bring with me?
trips2.answer: We suggest sunscreen, a hat, and a light jacket. All fishing equipment and refreshments are provided.

safety1.question: Is the boat suitable for families?
safety1.answer: Absolutely. We provide life jackets in all sizes and keep safety briefings kid-friendly.

safety2.question: What safety equipment is on board?
safety2.answer: Our boat is equipped with GPS, VHF radio, life rafts, first-aid kits, and emergency beacons.

payment1.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
payment1.answer: We accept credit cards, bank transfers, and cash payments on the day of the trip.

payment2.question: Do you require a deposit?
payment2.answer: A small deposit is required to confirm your booking, with the remainder due before departure.
